contracts.proof: Requires both turnsComplete and timelineComplete with consistent complete,nextCursor and monotonic historyVersion. Turn-only legacy public response fails closed. Both streams use bounded combined retention.
contracts.timeline: Native pages walk newest to oldest; each page is chronological. Incoming older page is prepended and stable-sorted by position. Shared positions across kinds allowed; dedup uses position and kind/turn/item identity. Ordinary items render once, preferring authoritative/live turn content; voice lifecycle, plain-text transcripts and promoted message references remain visible.
contracts.invalidation: History invalidation immediately aborts old traversal and revokes ready; late responses cannot restore proof. Voice started suppresses automatic refresh. Closed reloads full dual history. Explicit recheck supports other-owner voice state without loops. Navigation/epoch clears prior voice scope.
contracts.presentation: Canonical timeline order is used for ordinary positioned messages and realtime records. Unpositioned live items remain visible once until canonical history arrives. Promoted-item control locates existing message rather than duplicating it.
